provenance_note: Official file from the Senate's document service, a static response. The researcher downloaded it twice on 23 September 2026 with identical bytes, and the independent check downloaded it again the same day with the same byte count and SHA-256. The kept copy was re-hashed for this packet with the same result. This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, seals, coats of arms, signatures, diploma images or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: Scanned open vote list filed in the Denúncia nº 1/2016 case record (document 2 of 1 September 2016) in the Senate's document store.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: On the question whether the accused committed the crimes of responsibility charged and should be condemned to the loss of her office, the Senate voted from 13:32:14 to 13:34:50 on 31 August 2016 (133rd extraordinary deliberative session, opened 25 August 2016): yes 61, no 20, abstentions 0, total 81.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 only. Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Vice-presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded except the Vice-President's exercise of the office, recorded as rows only.
